Self-paced courses 11

Self-paced online courses, often with ACE or NCCRS credit recommendations. Your school decides which ones count.

Self-paced course provider

StraighterLine

Current offer. Broad self-paced course catalog, including business, general education and lab options. Confirm the exact course and receiving degree before purchasing.

Sophia Learning

Current offer. General education and other college-level courses through a subscription. Check developmental or noncredit exclusions and receiving-school applicability.

Study.com

Current offer. Free learning with a separate credit examination. Current Saylor University branding does not by itself establish institutional-origin transfer classification.

Exams & test prep 6

Show what you already know. Pass an exam and your school may award credit without a full course.

Credit exam

CLEP examinations

Current offer. Demonstrate existing knowledge or prepare independently across general education and business subjects.

See courses and pricing
Preparation & funding

Modern States CLEP preparation and vouchers

Current offer. Free CLEP preparation can qualify learners for matching exam vouchers and eligible test-center fee reimbursement.

See courses and pricing
Credit exam

DSST examinations

Credit-by-examination options. Five exact exam-form matches are documented for Liberty online undergraduate requirements; coverage for other exams and schools remains DegreeSteps research.

See courses and pricing
University exam

TESU TECEP examinations

Current offer. Course-specific examinations can address targeted requirements without taking a full instructional course.

See courses and pricing
Language assessment

ACTFL language proficiency assessments through LTI

Current assessment route. Existing language skills may support lower- or upper-level recommendations; actual university awards and duplication rules require separate checks.

See courses and pricing
Industry certification

Selected Microsoft certification examinations

Current qualifying route; individual exam availability needs review. Verify the exam is still schedulable as well as its recommendation period.

University-issued credit 8

Courses recorded on a college or university transcript. Your receiving school still decides how they apply.

University-partner courses

TEL Education partner-university courses

Current offer with eligibility limits. Official support directs adult learners to Briar Cliff; McMurry and Oklahoma Christian options require current high-school enrollment. Confirm partner eligibility and destination acceptance.

See courses and pricing
University courses

ASU Universal Learner Courses

Current offer. Institutional coursework can complement alternative-credit plans. Admitted degree-seeking ASU students are not eligible for this route.

See courses and pricing
School-mediated enrollment

Outlier by Savvas

Current high-school dual-enrollment offer through participating schools. General adult standalone enrollment needs review; older consumer pages do not prove current access.

See courses and pricing
University-partner courses

CPA Credits / Upper Iowa University courses

Current offer. Accounting and other targeted courses can address specific gaps. Degree transfer and professional-licensure eligibility are separate decisions.

University-partner courses

Westcott Courses / UMass Global

Math, writing, science and health prerequisites delivered by Westcott, with university credit through UMass Global.

University-partner courses

Portage Learning

Online science labs, healthcare prerequisites and general education courses with a college-issued transcript.

See courses and pricing
University courses

Christian Leaders Institute / College

Free Christian-focused learning with a separate academic-transcript pathway. College admission or verification requirements apply to eligible credit records.

University courses

WGU Single Courses

Individual university courses without admission to a full degree. Discounted prices, recurring extensions and assessments vary by course; an outside college decides how a completed course applies.

Training & prior learning 5

Certificates, workforce training and military learning that may already be worth college credit.

Certificate learning

Google Career Certificates through Coursera

Self-paced certificate bundles may support transfer when the college accepts the exact learning. Three reviewed ACE versions have completion windows ending November 30, 2026; a successor window has not been verified.

See courses and pricing
Certificate learning

IBM and other designated Coursera certificates

Current offer. The ACE catalog includes designated IBM, Meta, Microsoft, SAP, SAS, AWIT and DeepLearning credentials. Check recommendation dates and overlapping content before combining bundles.

See courses and pricing
Training

TEEX training

Training available; current credit eligibility needs review. Do not assume the historically advertised cybersecurity track totals remain earnable for college credit.

See courses and pricing
Training & possible conversion

FEMA Independent Study and optional college conversion

Current training and conversion routes. Check the eligible course list, paid conversion and destination acceptance before counting any degree credit.

See courses and pricing
Prior learning

Military training and Joint Services Transcript

Qualifying prior-learning route for learners with eligible military training. Review existing records before paying to repeat already-documented learning.

Historical routes 2

Useful when interpreting old learning records. These are not presented as new enrollment options.

Historical provider

OnlineDegree.com historical courses

Retired for new courses. Provider confirms its free courses stopped January 29, 2025; prior students can request transcript assistance.

See courses and pricing
Historical examination

UExcel historical examinations

Retired for new examinations since August 21, 2022. Preserve prior earned results, but do not recommend this as a future earning option.
